entities.summary: Stanley "Fox" Stevenson-Byrne, formerly known as Stan SB or Stan SSB, is an English singer-songwriter, DJ and producer of bass music, mostly drum and bass and glitch hop. He has released two albums and eleven EPs under Fox Stevenson, one under Stan SB, and has been featured on two compilations under Stan SB and eighteen under the name of Fox Stevenson.
